scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npm run dev --workspace @kinboard/api
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build --workspace @kinboard/api
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build:web && npm run cf:dev --workspace @kinboard/api
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run build:web:production && npm run build:cloudflare --workspace @kinboard/api
scripts.build:cloudflare:api: npm run build:web:production && npm run build:cloudflare:api --workspace @kinboard/api
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build:cloudflare && npm exec --workspace @kinboard/api -- wrangler deploy dist/server/entry.mjs --assets dist/client --config wrangler.jsonc --name kinboard --outdir dist/bundle
scripts.cf:deploy:api: npm run build:cloudflare:api && npm exec --workspace @kinboard/api -- wrangler deploy dist/server/entry.mjs --assets dist/client --config wrangler.api.jsonc --name kinboard-api --outdir dist/bundle
scripts.build:web:production: KINBOARD_PRODUCTION_API=true npm run build --workspace @kinboard/web && node scripts/stage-web.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace @kinboard/contracts && npm run check --workspace @kinboard/web && npm exec --workspace @kinboard/api -- astro check
